extraction.policy_summary: Himadri has a Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) Policy aligned with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, committing to equal opportunity for persons with disabilities across recruitment, training, promotion and remuneration. A web link to the policy is provided.
extraction.accommodation_process_summary: Himadri has conducted a systematic mapping of job roles across functions to identify positions suitable for differently abled individuals, considering physical demands, hazards and safety requirements; appointments are aligned with this mapping, and employees 'receive necessary accommodations to perform effectively.' No response-time commitment or approval workflow is described.
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: Differently abled employees and workers table: 1 permanent differently abled employee (male, 100%), 0 other-than-permanent differently abled employees, and 0 differently abled workers (permanent or other-than-permanent), against a total workforce of 1,395 employees and 1,798 workers.
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: Filing states facilities/offices are accessible to differently abled workforce and visitors per the RPwD Act, 2016, with 'continuous upgrading of infrastructure to remove remaining barriers,' and that 'all new construction and renovations incorporate accessibility as a core design requirement.' Described as an ongoing, not one-time, improvement programme.
extraction.recruitment_details: DEI Policy commits to equal opportunity for PwD in recruitment; job roles are systematically mapped across functions to identify positions suitable for differently abled individuals based on physical demands, hazards and safety requirements, with appointments aligned to this mapping. Hiring practices generally (not PwD-specific) include blind resume screening and diverse interview panels. No numeric PwD hiring target or attainment figure is disclosed.
extraction.culture_practices_details: 'Beyond physical access, Himadri fosters an inclusive culture where differently abled individuals are treated with dignity, have equal access to development and career opportunities and receive necessary accommodations to perform effectively.' No specific ERG, flexible-work policy, or response-time commitment for PwD is named.
extraction.compliance_details: In response to the mandated BRSR questions, Himadri answers 'Yes' that its premises/offices are accessible to differently abled workforce and visitors 'as per the requirements of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016,' while also acknowledging 'remaining barriers' are being addressed on an ongoing basis, and confirms it has an equal opportunity policy aligned with the RPwD Act, 2016. No specific statutory quota (e.g., 3%/4% employment quota) attainment figure or WCAG conformance level is stated.
